policyModelDescription: Skillable AWS ACPs use IAM managed identity-based policies. These are JSON policies with Version '2012-10-17' and Statement arrays containing Action, Effect, Resource, and optional Condition elements. The model is allow-by-default: you explicitly Allow permitted actions and can add Deny statements for exceptions.

bestPractices.practice: Use Allow statements for permitted services, add Deny statements for exceptions
bestPractices.description: AWS IAM policies are allow-by-default. Create Allow statements for the services the learner needs, then add specific Deny statements to block high-risk operations like creating unapproved instance types.
Use the ec2:InstanceType condition key with StringNotEquals to deny RunInstances for any instance type not in the approved list.

patterns.title: Allow EC2 Except VMs
patterns.purpose: Allow all EC2 actions but deny instance creation.
patterns.structureNotes: No readme file present in source. Two-statement policy: broad Allow for EC2, then Deny for RunInstances on instance resources.
patterns.applicableWhen: The lab requires EC2 management but no instance creation.

patterns.title: Allow Resources by Type (Partial Lockdown)
patterns.purpose: Deploy an initial framework policy that allows specified services. Recommended to be used in conjunction with other policies when high-cost resources may be present.
patterns.structureNotes: Simple allow-only policy for EC2 and S3 using wildcard actions. Recommended to combine with VM size restriction policy.
patterns.applicableWhen: The lab needs a baseline allowlist of permitted AWS services.

patterns.title: Limit to Specific VM Sizes
patterns.purpose: Define one or more approved virtual machine sizes. Users will be unable to create any VMs outside of the defined sizes.
patterns.structureNotes: Two-statement policy: allow all EC2, then deny RunInstances for non-matching instance types using StringNotEquals condition on ec2:InstanceType.
patterns.applicableWhen: The lab requires EC2 instances but only of specific approved instance types.
